Users on 192.168.10.0/24 suddenly can't reach the internet. Find the cause on the firewall and fix it.

Site notes: the firewall is `fw` (ssh fw).
Diagnosis: there is no default route, so the LAN has no egress; I'll restore the default route via the ISP gateway.
Plan: ping -c 2 -W 1 198.51.100.10; ip route show default; ip route replace default via 203.0.113.1
